name: NeuManifold
definition: A two- (or three-) stage pipeline for neural watertight manifold reconstruction with efficient rendering support. Stage 1 initializes geometry and appearance networks via volume rendering. Stage 2 optimizes topology, geometry, and appearance using differentiable rasterization with a proposed differentiable marching cubes (DiffMC) iso-surface extraction. Stage 3 optionally fine-tunes mesh vertex positions and appearance to improve rendering quality.
summary: NeuManifold reconstructs watertight 3D meshes from 2D images using a differentiable marching cubes algorithm to avoid artifacts and enable real-time rendering.
